lines.en: I run across the End stone.

lines.zh: 这里没有草，也没有水，只有末地的石头。
lines.en: No grass, no water, only End stone.
The violet sky never sets.
I run faster than sound.
Scorch marks stay where I pass.
My name garbles on the screen.
You need not say it aloud.
You only need to run.
Gravel kicks up under my feet.

lines.zh: 我的影子被紫光拉得很长。
lines.en: The violet light stretches my shadow long.
I do not watch the ground when I run.
I know this route well.
I stand at the edge of this island.
Under the island there's only empty purple.
I never look down.
The End's wind is dead.
I wait for someone to come.
Only I am on this island.
And those black pillars.
I count them one by one.
I tap the stone with my toe.
It knocks hollow.
There are old marks on the pillar.
I did not make them.
You came through the portal.
I saw that violet flash.

lines.zh: 你身上还带着主世界的味道。
lines.en: You still carry the Overworld's smell.
That smell will fade eventually.
Stay long enough and it fades.
Like this place itself.
Stay long enough and your eyes turn purple.
You grip your weapon tightly.
That will not help here.
I do not mean to reason.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还没适应这里的紫。
lines.en: Your eyes have not adjusted to the violet.
I see clearly here.

lines.zh: 你进一尺，我退一尺，再绕回来。
lines.en: You take a step, I give one - then circle back.
Are you counting these steps.
How long have you stood here.
Your lips have gone violet.
That is not from the cold.
In the End, my name is scrambled.
Violet blood splashes the stone.
I retreat beside a pillar.
My knee split - now I run faster.

lines.zh: 我按住腿，血从指缝出来。
lines.en: I press my leg; blood seeps between my fingers.
I spit violet blood.
My breathing whistles.
I wipe the blood on the stone.
It is the same colour as the sky.

lines.zh: 紫血滴在石上，我撑起来。
lines.en: Purple blood drips on stone as I push myself up.

lines.zh: 你带的那些留在门那边了。
lines.en: What you brought stayed by the portal.
There is nothing to eat here.
And I do not intend to share.
The smell you brought from the Overworld.
This place will wear it away.
It is almost gone from you.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西早就不成了。
lines.en: What you hold is already spoiled.
You dropped it into a stone crack.
That stone crack runs deep.
Holding it high will not help.
You hit my shoulder.
My End name is all garbled characters.
You were driven back two steps.
The stone here is uneven.

lines.zh: 末地的石头，都在我脚下。
lines.en: The End's stone lies under my feet.
I shifted half a step aside.
Your elbow met my ribs.
We each took a step back.
You squeezed past my hand.
I stop and let you pass.

lines.zh: 末地里，第二个我不会来。
lines.en: In the End, a second me will not come.
What you see is all of it.
The End can only grow one of me.
Things like us do not pair.
Even echoes do not last here.

lines.zh: 这岛上只站得下一个我。
lines.en: This island has room for only one of me.

lines.zh: 这里不会再有第二个我。
lines.en: There will never be a second me here.

lines.zh: 我在这岛上待得太久了。
lines.en: I have been on this island far too long.
I would not seek a mate here.
If you really must know: no.
There is a piece of End stone on the ground.
End stone moves when I kick it.
It rolls into the void.
I kick another.
This one falls slowly.
It stops at the island's edge.
I did not go to pick it up.
It nearly fell.
I crouch, hand stopping in midair.
Then let it be.
You stepped on the black blocks.

lines.zh: 这里的每块石头都记得我。
lines.en: Every stone here remembers me.
They tell me where you are.
You will not get far here.
The ground where you stand begins to crumble.
The stone here is brittle.
You went back three steps.
I counted those three steps.

lines.zh: 你踩的每块末地石都在报信。
lines.en: Every end stone you step on reports to me.
You are the only thing making noise.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在石缝里回响。
lines.en: Your heartbeat echoes in the stone cracks.
I heard you miss a step.
I am already ahead of you.

lines.zh: 紫光里，我比影子快一步。
lines.en: In the purple light I'm a step ahead of your shadow.
You cannot tell which way I went.
The violet light stretches the shadows.
I am inside them.
I run around the pillar.
Each lap brings me closer.
You are looking the wrong way.
Light deceives here.

lines.zh: 我在你左边第三根柱子那里。
lines.en: I am at the third pillar to your left.
You have already run past.
There is no call to chase.
You will come around again.
I stop in the pillar's shade.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在这里特别响。
lines.en: Your breathing is very loud here.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞上你的肋骨，停不下。
lines.en: My shoulder meets your ribs and doesn't stop.

lines.zh: 你的护甲擦出一串火花。
lines.en: Your armor throws a string of sparks.
You are driven toward the edge.
I hit the side of your knee.
Your leg is knocked out of line.
I ram again on the way past.
You are down on the stone.

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸在你护甲上。
lines.en: My fist lands on your armor.
Sparks fly off.
The second is higher.
I strike from behind the pillar.
You guarded the wrong side.

lines.zh: 末地的一座浮岛上有了动静。
lines.en: Something stirs on one of the End islands.

lines.zh: 我在末地的石头上踩着碎石出来。
lines.en: I come out over the stony ground of the End.

lines.zh: 这里的天空一直是那个颜色。
lines.en: The sky here never changes colour.
I look up.

lines.zh: 这里是末地，你来做什么。
lines.en: This is the End, what are you doing here?
The portal's violet light has not faded.
I am inside it.
You came too late.
There is no bridge between the islands.
I leap the gaps.
A corner of stone breaks where I land.

lines.zh: 紫色的布料挂在我身上。
lines.en: Violet cloth hangs from me.
That is no cape.

lines.zh: 我落在最边上的一块石头上。
lines.en: I land on the outermost stone.
The edge is one foot wide.

lines.zh: 紫火燎过我的鞋，我跺了两下。
lines.en: Violet fire catches my shoe; I stamp twice.
I drop and catch the island's edge.
There is no water here, only the void.

lines.zh: 爆风把碎石掀起来一片。
lines.en: The blast throws up a sheet of rubble.
Something sharp is in my leg.
That spell halts my feet.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是力气在退。
lines.en: I do not eat; my strength is simply draining.

lines.zh: 雷打在紫色天里，一道白光。
lines.en: Lightning splits the violet sky, a white line.
Beneath my feet is nothing.
